name: BSP_InputSettings_GetSingleton
evidence: Hypothesis, not a recovered symbol. Packet app_init_input, Ghidra read-only. Called from BSP_Application_Initialize at 0073da94. __cdecl, RET with no operand, returns the singleton in EAX. Lazy getter over DAT_00e198e8 under the critical section at BSP_SingletonLifetime_GetManager()+0x10; allocates 0x540 through 00bf681b, constructs with 006ab6b0 and registers with BSP_SingletonLifetime_Register. A failed allocation stores null and still registers. 006ab6b0 calls 006a7be0 on itself, so the data tables load during construction. Evidence: docs/APP_INIT_INPUT.md; reports/app_init_input.json.
